verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own corporate-card page claims 1% cashback on every purchase, so cashback on card spend is a first-party capability. The pack never says how cashback is credited or whether redemption needs any manual steps, so the 'automatic, no manual redemption' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic crediting with no redemption steps, details on where and when cashback is applied, eligibility terms or caps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn automatic cashback on card spend without manual redemption steps
